title: SUPPORT HUNT SABOTEURS SWEDEN FIGHTING THE WOLF CULL!
content:
via: @huntsabssweden on IG







“On January 2nd the wolf hunt starts in Sweden and 72 wolves have been sentenced to lose their lives in brutal and ruthless ways.The hunters will tear families apart, torture them to death and traumatize not only the wolves but all the inhabitants of the forest. The wolf hatred is both great and accepted in Sweden which results in wolves being tortured and poisoned to death. Wolves are also a big part of the trophy hunt which means that their lives will be sold to the highest bidder, both legally and illegally.

Hunt Saboteurs Sweden intends to make the hunting difficult and prevent the killing in every possible way to protect the wolves. We will do everything in our power to protect and save these innocent and amazing creatures from the hunters bloodlust.

WHY DONATIONS ARE NEEDED: Unfortunately it costs a lot to sabotage a hunt. The sabs needs food and shelter but also cars and petrol since the hunt is taking place in the woods and sometimes very far away from the society. We always make sure to choose the cheapest options of everything.

author: unoffensiveadmin
title: GREAT NEWS! THE SUCCESSOR TO THE TALON CONSPIRACY HAS BEEN RELEASED!
content:
We couldn’t be happier to announce this. The Talon Conspiracy was a website that archived hundreds of animal liberation and earth liberation magazines, providing a platform to look into the past, learn from what the movement did decades prior, and plot the next steps for total liberation.




For a while, Talon was not available. Now, a new website has been launched, allowing you to read all the content Talon had. Go and check it out, from single zines from the 80s and 90s to long running publications like HOWL or the ALFsg magazine, there are heaps and heaps of material to read and learn from, for free, available to download or read online!




Go visit the Animal Freedom Library right now, and share far and wide, everybody should know about this!




www.animalfreedom.is

author: unoffensiveadmin
title: 17 HENS LIBERATED IN SOLIDARITY WITH RUCIO, CASO SUSARON.
content:
October, Argentina.










via: @anarcoveganismo.arg




ENGLISH (translation):




“There are nine of us hiding in the night, lying in wait. Our objective is crystal clear: we must get someone out of those cages—no matter what. On the way to the site (a farm for egg laying hens) we coordinate our roles; each person is vital and essential to achieving this act of animal liberation tonight.

We arrive in the dead of night, the lights in the sheds still on. As we finish cutting through the wire fencing, the lights go out. ‘GO! THIS IS OUR CHANCE!’ We wait a few moments, then slip inside—and there they are, terrified, surrounded by their own excrement and rats.

We begin opening the cages. The cool night air, the tall grass, and our dark clothing helped us reach them. We fill our bags and ensure the area is clear for our exit. Our companions are waiting by the fence, others in the cars; we load them up and leave, looking back at all those we couldn’t rescue today; but perhaps we will tomorrow, because this doesn’t end here.

This is a war against speciesism, a fight to liberate the slaves of an exploitative, murderous system.

Against all odds, and against all authority.

There is no veganism without animal liberation.

author: unoffensiveadmin
title: SIXTY-SIX HENS LIBERATED FROM AN EGG LAYING FARM.
content:
Central Italy, September




received anonymously via email:




“On a full moon night 66 hens were helped to break free from a well known laying farm, famous in the area for its ‘free range’ practices.




Of course the reality is stinking sheds packed with hens deprived of anything a hen would need. There is no ethical farming if it involves animal exploitation!




The 66 are now safe in their new home.




We’ll come back for the others! Until every cage is empty”

author: unoffensiveadmin
title: OVER A DOZEN CHICKENS LIBERATED IN MEMORY OF THE T&S BUNS
content:
31st of October 2026 Midlands







received anonymously via email:




“One of us had driven past and seen signs advertising ‘fresh eggs’, a few big barns were visible from the road further down. A few nights later once we’d lined up good homes we came back as a small group with carriers. We had brought a crowbar and some conveniently sized bolt cutters to assist us with entry but the doors weren’t locked, always check the doors. We were greeted by the standard sight of a filthy barn crammed with thousands of hens looking worse for wear. They were good as gold and stayed quiet on the walk back and seemed happy with their new temporary accommodation when we got them home.




We dedicate this action to the T&S rabbits, the ones that got out and the ones that didn’t. We send our greetings to every human that helped pave the way to their freedom. But the fight goes on until every cage is empty.”

author: unoffensiveadmin
title: LARSEN TRAP DESTROYED, MAGPIE LIBERATED. IN SOLIDARITY WITH DES.
content:
received anonymously via email:




“All across the UK, magpies are used as live bait in Larsen cages to trap and kill other magpies. The conditions of these majestic wild birds are horrendous – forced into a tiny wire cage filled with often multiple rotting bodies of other birds, no room to even stretch their wings. We happened to come across one in the countryside and released the imprisoned magpie and destroyed the cage. In solidarity with Des, and imprisoned vegan anarchist on turtle island.




For the wild!”

author: unoffensiveadmin
title: ANONYMOUS GROUP LIBERATES 100 HENS FROM A BARN
content:
October, France.




received anonymously via email:







“We believe that the structures of speciesism are vulnerable and accessible.




Last week, we – an anonymous group – went to a factory farm in France and helped 100 hens escape from it. A few hours later, the liberated hens were already running on the grass and petting each other.




Rage consumed us when we arrived at the barn. The sky was dark, and everything was silent except for their screams and talks inside.




We entered and took them out, as fast as we could. After that, the night didn’t have the same color. We could hear them talk in their transport cages but we knew that they were free from harm, at last.







And, of course, we still deeply think of the ones who are still inside. We will continue to fight so that, one day, everyone could be free and safe.




If you can, please go inside those places of oppression, open the cages and take them out. You will experience more rage, fear and hope that what you are probably used to but every second of it will be so worth it. Because when you go on with your daily life later, you will know that the people you helped escape are now free and safe.







Thank you to everyone who fight alongside other animals and good luck with your actions.”

author: unoffensiveadmin
title: TWO HENS LIBERATED FROM A BARN.
content:
Summer, Utah USA.







received anonymously via email:




“On a hot summer morning at a Utah cage free farm, after some surveillance, we were able to identify entrances into the massive death prisons, but quickly realized numerous humans were nearby and entering our building of choice. We pivoted and moved to the furthest shed away and quickly entered. Upon entering, we found hundreds of chickens crammed together, some of them dead stuck underneath metal beams.




When grabbing these chickens, we expected to be met with fear and resistance. Instead we met 2 gentle birds who had seemingly given up on their lives, knowing nothing but suffering and pain. We like to imagine they both willingly got into my arms, knowing we were there to help bring them into a better world, but we think its far more likely that they felt they had nothing to struggle or fight for. They were docile and quiet towards us while being transported despite knowing nothing from humans but cruelty.




We say to those watching and listening, are you not horrified when you see the countless images of animal cruelty? Does your heart, when faced with the images of their torment, not also feel total repulsion and an obligation to act? Now is the time. All you need is an address, a vehicle, and the will to act.
